source_conflicts: Product page says six extra slanted stars; current detailed documentation and Figure 2 support four added stars plus two side squares. Use the exact supplied/official artwork topology.
Nominal 16:9 names camera framing; supplied and official whole-chart preview is 640 by 370 including borders, so do not force the full raster to 16:9 by anisotropic scaling.
Product-page PDF info sheet is a 2021/2017 chart document, not a 2023 geometry reference.
Current documentation retains some 2017 text near 2023 additions; record section and chart revision for every reference.
